expected_root_cause: The product-service process was unresponsive because its container was paused.
expected_symptoms: order-service returns 503 responses for order creation requests.
Connection failures to product-service appear in order-service logs.
Dependency spans for product-service are absent or fail.
expected_evidence: Docker events show product-service paused and later unpaused.
order-service logs contain product-service connection failures.
Prometheus HTTP 5xx counters increase for order creation requests.
Jaeger traces show failed or missing product-service dependency spans.
expected_resolution: Safely unpause the product-service container and verify its health endpoint, order-service dependency calls, and error rate recover.

timeline.event: Capture healthy product-service calls and order creation metrics.
order-service dependency calls fail and order creation returns 503 responses.
Unpause product-service and confirm successful dependency calls resume.
